annotations.title: Check a web page's AI-search readiness

description: Call when: a user asks whether a web page can be found, read and trusted by AI search engines (ChatGPT search, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, Gemini). Fetches that one public page once. Returns score, grade, top fixes and every check. Do not call: for private or intranet addresses (refused), to monitor a site repeatedly, or to measure actual AI citations.

url.description: The full public address of the page, starting with https:// or http://
url.title: Url

name: check_ai_readiness

outputSchema.description:
ai_agents_3 (10 Nov 2026): the check's answer as a typed output (an outputSchema, like the EA tools). extra="allow": a key the
checker adds later is kept in structuredContent, never dropped; the declared keys are the ones a live answer had on 10 Nov
